DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い上げの包みは、この袋にお入れしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I put your purchased package in this bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。魚を入れたいですが、保冷袋の口が狭くて斜めになりそうです。平らに入るか一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 魚包みが狭い保冷袋へ平らに入るか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to put the fish in, but the cooler bag's opening is narrow, so it may end up tilted. Please help me check whether it will fit flat.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether the fish package will fit flat in the narrow cooler bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中の物をいったん出すと、底まで使えそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If we take the things inside out for a moment, it looks as though we can use the whole bottom.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飲み物が入っています。それを外の袋へ移します。魚の包みだけなら、この底へ置けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲物を移し魚のみ底へ置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a drink inside. I'll move it to the outer bag. With just the fish package, it looks as though it will fit on the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move the drink and place only the fish at the bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この向きで包みを入れられます。ふたを閉める前に、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The package can go in facing this way. Please check before closing the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入りました。保冷剤を入れる分の余裕もあります。横に添えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 収納を確認し保冷剤位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits. There's also room for an ice pack. May I put it alongside?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm it fits and ask where to put the ice pack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに入れて、口を閉じてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put it here and try closing the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉じられました。取っ手を持ったときも、包みが傾かないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口閉じと取手保持時の傾きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It closes. I'll also check that the package doesn't tilt when I hold the handles.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the bag closes and whether the package tilts when held by the handles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お買い物は、これでおそろいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。追加は買わず、この魚を持って帰ります。外へ出てからもう一度包み直さずに済んで助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加購入せず魚を運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't buy anything else; I'll take this fish home. I'm glad I won't have to repack it again after going outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will carry the fish home without buying more. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋に収まりましたね。それでは、お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: It fits in the bag now. Please take it home carefully. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 机の上にこぼれてしまいましたね。おけがはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's spilled onto the table. Are you hurt?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: けがはありません。袖が容器に当たって、焼きそばが机にこぼれました。拭く物をいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: けがなしと容器転倒を伝え拭き物を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not hurt. My sleeve caught the container, and the fried noodles spilled onto the table. Could I have something to wipe it up with?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are unhurt, explain how the container tipped, and ask for something to wipe with. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの布をお使いください。容器はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this cloth. We'll take the container here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。残った料理を別の容器へ移さず、この容器ごと片付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 料理を移さず容器ごとの片付けを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Please clear away this whole container without transferring the remaining food into another one.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to clear the container and food together without transferring the food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 机を拭く間、お荷物をこちらへ寄せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you move your belongings over here while you wipe the table?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鞄を自分の膝へ置きます。服には付いていませんが、机の端にもソースがあるので、そこまで拭きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鞄を膝へ移しソース付着範囲を拭くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put my bag on my lap. None got on my clothes, but there's sauce on the table edge too, so I'll wipe that as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move your bag to your lap and wipe the whole area with sauce on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 布が汚れましたら、こちらの袋へ入れてお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When the cloth is dirty, please put it in this bag and give it to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 拭けました。使った布をこの袋へ入れます。机の下に落ちた箸もありますが、店員さんに渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用布袋と床箸の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've wiped it up. I'll put the used cloth in this bag. Some chopsticks fell under the table too; may I give those to a staff member?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the bagged used cloth and the chopsticks on the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらでまとめて片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll clear them all away here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箸をお渡しします。今日は追加を頼まず、手元を整えてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箸を渡し追加注文せず片付け後帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Here are the chopsticks. I won't order anything more today; I'll get my things in order and then go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the chopsticks and say you will tidy up and leave without ordering more. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。それでは、お荷物をお忘れなく。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken them. Please remember your belongings and have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 下船後のお待ち合わせについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about meeting someone after disembarking?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が迎えに来ます。船のそばまで来ると言っていますが、私は降りてから人の少ない所で会いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 下船後船際以外の合流場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend is coming to meet me. They say they'll come right up to the boat, but I'd prefer to meet somewhere less crowded after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a meeting place away from the boat after disembarking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 下船する通路を出た、こちらの「港案内所」の表示前でしたら説明しやすいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: In front of this ‘Port Information Office’ sign, after leaving the disembarkation walkway, should be easy to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「港案内所」ですね。その名前をメモします。友人には船の前へ来ず、港案内所の表示前で待ってほしいと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 港案内所名を控え友人へ表示前待機を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: ‘Port Information Office,’ right. I'll note the name. I'll tell my friend not to come to the front of the boat, but to wait in front of that sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Note the Port Information Office name and ask your friend to wait in front of its sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お友達は、車でいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your friend coming by car?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 徒歩です。私は大きい荷物がないので、自分で表示まで歩けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人徒歩本人も荷物少なく歩けると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On foot. I don't have any large luggage, so I can walk to the sign myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is walking and you can walk too because you have little luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 船が到着しても、全員が降りるまで時間がかかることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even after the boat arrives, it can take time for everyone to get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、着いた時刻だけで待ち合わせを決めず、私が降りて表示の前に着いたら電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示到着後に電話すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't set the meeting time based only on the arrival time. I'll call once I've disembarked and reached the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will call after reaching the sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰りの乗船も、ご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you planning to take the boat back too?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りは友人と陸路で行きます。今日はこの下船後の場所だけ確認できれば大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰り陸路で今日の合流案内のみ必要と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll travel back overland with my friend. I only need to confirm this meeting place after getting off today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your return journey is overland and you only need today's meeting-place guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をご利用ください。お友達と無事に会えますように。お気をつけてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this information, then. I hope you meet your friend without trouble. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の写真についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about photographs of the area?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父の家で古い港の写真を見つけました。どこで撮ったものか、分かる方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖父の古港写真の撮影場所を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found an old photograph of the port at my grandfather's house. I'd like to ask someone knowledgeable where it was taken.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want advice on where an old port photograph from your grandfather's house was taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真について担当へ取り次げます。何枚お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can refer you to the person responsible for photographs. How many do you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は携帯に写した一枚だけです。元の写真は祖父の家にあり、裏に文字が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯表面一枚と祖父保管の裏文字を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Today I only have one image copied onto my phone. The original is at my grandfather's house, and there's writing on its back.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have one front image on your phone and the original with writing on its back is at your grandfather's house. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 裏の文字も、写真と一緒に確認できると手がかりになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Being able to check the writing on the back together with the photograph would provide a clue.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 祖父に頼んで、裏も写してもらいます。字が読める大きさで送ってもらうつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読める大きさの裏面写真を祖父へ頼むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask my grandfather to photograph the back too. I'll ask him to send it large enough to read the writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your grandfather for a readable photograph of the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ相談する際、お名前と連絡先をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When consulting the person in charge, please give your name and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらに書きます。祖父にも話を聞いてから、分かる範囲の元の写真の撮影時期と、残っている文字をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名連絡先と分かる元写真撮影時期や裏文字をまとめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write them here. After talking with my grandfather too, I'll put together what we know about when the original photograph was taken and the surviving writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide your name and contact details and say you will organize the known date information and writing from the original photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当からご連絡できるよう、ご希望の連絡方法も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also ask your preferred contact method so the person in charge can reach you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メールでお願いします。裏の写真が届いたら、自分のメモと一緒に送れるよう準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メール連絡希望で裏面とメモを送付準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Email, please. When the image of the back arrives, I'll prepare it to send along with my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request email contact and say you will prepare to send the back image and your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご希望を担当へお伝えします。お祖父様とのお話も伺えるのを楽しみにしております。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll pass your preference to the person in charge. We look forward to hearing about your conversation with your grandfather too. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 実演をお楽しみいただけましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が感想を話したいと言っていますが、今は席を立つ人が多いです。少し待ってから出てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 終演混雑が落ち着くまで席で待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend wants to talk about it, but lots of people are getting up now. May we wait a little before leaving?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can wait in your seats until the post-performance crowd settles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出口へ向かう方が落ち着くまで、今のお席でお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may wait in your current seats until the people heading for the exit have cleared.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。立ったまま通路で話さず、友人には座って短く話してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立ち話せず着席で友人の短感想を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. We won't stand talking in the aisle; I'll ask my friend to sit and tell me their impressions briefly.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will hear your friend's brief impressions while seated rather than standing in the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お忘れ物の確認も、この間にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your belongings during that time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手元に鞄はあります。席の下に水筒を置いたので、それを取ってから話を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席下水筒を取り私物を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my bag with me. I put my water bottle under the seat, so I'll get it before listening.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Retrieve your water bottle from under the seat and check your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そろそろ通路が空いてきました。お帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The aisle is clearing now. Are you ready to leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。感想は館内を出てから続けます。二人とも荷物を持ったので、出口の方向を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 感想は後に続け退出方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We'll continue talking about our impressions after leaving the building. We both have our things, so could you tell us which way the exit is?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will continue the conversation later and ask the direction out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの通路を進むと、出口の表示がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow this aisle, and you'll see the exit sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その表示へ向かいます。友人を先に行かせ、私は落とした物がないか席を一度見てから続きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出口へ向かい最後に席の落とし物を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll head for that sign. I'll let my friend go first, check the seat once for anything dropped, and then follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will head to the exit and make a final check around your seat for dropped items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、出口へゆっくりお進みください。ご観覧ありがとうございました。どうぞよい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make your way to the exit slowly, then. Thank you for watching, and have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りになる道は、お分かりになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you understand your route back now?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行きたい所までは分かりました。帰りもここを通りたいですが、紙の地図を折ったら途中が隠れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折った地図で隠れた帰路の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I understand the way to my destination. I'd like to come back through here too, but folding the paper map hid part of the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the return route hidden by a fold in the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図を広げて、帰りの道を指しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's open the map and point out the way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。目的地はここです。私が書いた星印から、この交番へ戻る順番を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 星印目的地から交番への順路を示してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. My destination is here. I'd like to see the route from the star I drew back to this police box.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to show the route from your starred destination back to the police box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの道を戻り、この角を曲がると交番です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Go back along this road and turn this corner to reach the police box.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道をたどれました。交番の手前の角に小さい丸を付けて、星印とは別の目印にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がり角に丸印を追加すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could trace the route. I'll add a small circle at the corner before the police box as a separate marker from the star.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will add a circle at the turning corner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この周辺の地図でしたら、お持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may take this map of the local area home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。今回は帰りも歩くので、この見えている範囲を折り目の外に出して持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路部分を見えるよう折り直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. I'll walk back this time too, so I'll carry it folded with this route visible outside the fold.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will refold the map to keep the return route visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you managed to refold it?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。星の目的地と丸の曲がり角が両方見えます。帰りは丸の角から交番へ戻り、その先は自分の家への道を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両目印を確認し交番経由で自宅へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I can see both the starred destination and the circled turning corner. On the way back, I'll go from that corner to the police box, then follow the route I know to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both markers and say you will return home by way of the police box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その地図をお持ちください。迷われたらまたお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take that map, then. If you get lost, ask us again. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会社へ提出する用紙についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a form to submit to your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社でもらった紙に、給与の振込先を書くように言われました。銀行で聞きたいことを、この紙に書いて渡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与振込先用紙について質問を書いて渡せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company gave me this form and told me to enter my salary deposit account. May I write my questions for the bank on this paper and hand it to you?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can hand over written questions about the salary-deposit form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご質問を書いていただけます。どの項目が分かりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may write your questions down. Which item don't you understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支店の名前を書く欄です。手元の通帳にある漢字が読めないので、読み方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支店名漢字の場所と読み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The field for the branch name. I can't read the kanji in my bankbook, so I'd like to ask how to pronounce it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about where the branch-name kanji are and how to read them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳を拝見します。こちらは「港支店」です。「港」は「みなと」と読みます。読み方も横に仮名で書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see your bankbook. This is Minato Branch. The character meaning ‘port’ is read ‘minato.’ I'll write the pronunciation in kana beside it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 港支店、みなとですね。会社の用紙には漢字で写し、自分のメモには読み方を書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 港支店みなとの読みを確認し会社用紙漢字と自分メモ仮名を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Minato Branch, ‘minato,’ right. I'll copy the kanji onto the company form and write the pronunciation in my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the reading of Minato Branch and distinguish the kanji on the company form from the kana in your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、会社から記入を求められた項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other fields the company has asked you to complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号の欄です。どの番号か分からないので、この欄の見出しを見て説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明番号欄の見出しを示し説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number field. I don't know which number it means, so could you explain by looking at this field's heading?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the heading of an unclear number field and ask for an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの見出しは口座番号です。通帳の該当箇所と照らしてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This heading means account number. Let's compare it with the corresponding place in your bankbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。数字は家で落ち着いて写します。今日は支店の欄と口座番号の場所を聞けたので、このメモを持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座番号場所を理解し家で転記すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know where it is now. I'll copy the digits calmly at home. I've checked the branch field and account-number location today, so I'll take these notes home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understand where the account number is and will copy it at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、用紙と通帳をお戻しします。会社へのご準備にお役立てください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-NUMAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your form and bankbook back. I hope this helps you prepare for your company. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水やりの後、気付いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice anything after watering?

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通路に品種の札が二枚落ちています。水が流れた後に見つけましたが、どのトレーから出たのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水の後に落ちた二品種札の元トレーが不明と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two variety labels are lying in the passage. I found them after the water ran through, but I don't know which trays they came from.
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the original trays of two fallen variety labels found after watering are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札を苗の所へ戻しましたか。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you put the labels back by the seedlings?

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ戻していません。葉の形が似ていて、私にはどちらの苗か分かりません。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札は未返却で葉が似ており品種を判別できないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. The leaves look similar, and I can't tell which seedlings they belong to.
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you have not replaced the labels and cannot distinguish the varieties because the leaves look similar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 札は二枚ともこちらの受け皿へ置いてください。配置表と照合します。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put both labels in this tray. We'll compare them with the layout plan.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け皿に置きます。この通路で見つけたので、配置表でも場所を示します。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二札を受け皿へ置き発見場所を配置表で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put them in the tray. I found them in this passage, so I'll show the location on the plan too.
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Place both labels in the tray and show where you found them on the layout plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 苗やトレーの配置は動かしましたか。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you moved any seedlings or trays?

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 動かしていません。水やり前の写真ならありますが、札の文字は小さくて読めません。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配置は未移動で事前写真はあるが文字は読めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I have a photo from before watering, but the writing on the labels is too small to read.
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not changed the layout and have a prior photo, but its label text is unreadable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その写真と、見つけた位置を見せてください。確認まで札の差直しは待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show me that photo and where you found the labels. Let's wait to reinsert them until we've checked.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真と見つけた位置をお見せします。札を戻す場所が分かったら、差し直してよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と発見位置を示し確認後の札差し直しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show you the photo and the places I found them. Once you know where the labels belong, please tell me whether I can put them back.
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the photo and discovery locations and ask about replacing the labels after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 報告を受け取りました。配置表を確認します。
DLG-SC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your report. I'll check the layout plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の説明で気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the exhibit explanation you'd like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この図は赤と青の糸ですが、展示の布は白く見えます。色が落ちた布なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の赤青と白い現物の違いを退色かと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The threads in this diagram are red and blue, but the displayed cloth looks white. Has the cloth's color faded?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether fading explains the difference between the diagram's red and blue and the white exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の横に、縦糸を赤、横糸を青で示すという凡例があります。実際の糸色を表す図ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The key beside the diagram says warp threads are shown in red and weft in blue. The diagram doesn't show their actual colors.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 凡例を見落としていました。赤と青は糸の向きを表しているんですね。交わる所をもう少し近くで見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 凡例を理解し糸が交わる所を近くで見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I overlooked the key. So red and blue show the directions of the threads. Could I look more closely at where they cross?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the key and ask to look more closely at the crossing threads. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この拡大写真では、糸が交わる所を見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the crossing threads in this enlarged photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 拡大写真だと分かりやすいです。図の赤い線がどの糸に当たるか、指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拡大写真で図の線に対応する糸を示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's easier to understand in the enlarged photo. Could you point out which thread corresponds to the red line in the diagram?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to point out the thread in the enlarged photo corresponding to the diagram's line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示のガラスには触れず、この位置からご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look from this position without touching the exhibit glass.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから見ます。材質も知りたいのですが、どこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定位置から見て材質の表示場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look from here. I'd also like to know the material; where is that written?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: View from the designated position and ask where the material information is displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 材質は、作品名の下の表示にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The material is listed beneath the work's title.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作品名の下ですね。図と表示をメモしたいので、この場所で書いていても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材質表示を確認しその場でメモしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Under the title, right. I'd like to note the diagram and label. Is it all right to write here?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the material label and ask whether you may take notes there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通路を空けていただければ大丈夫です。どうぞ見比べながらご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's fine if you keep the passage clear. Please compare them as you look.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この一段をやり直してみましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: やり直すなら糸を切るのかと思いました。まだ何も切っていません。どこをほどくのか見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: やり直しを切断と思ったが未実施と説明し実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought redoing it meant cutting the thread. I haven't cut anything yet. Please show me where to undo it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought redoing meant cutting but have not done so, and request a demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今入れた横糸の一段です。縦糸を切る指示ではありません。まず私が示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's the one row of weft you just inserted. I'm not telling you to cut the warp. I'll show you first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一段だけですね。どこから引けばいいか、実演を見ながら覚えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象の一段を確認し引く所を実演で見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just this row, right. I'd like to learn where to pull by watching your demonstration.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the one row involved and ask to see where to pull in a demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 糸の端は、どちらに残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which side has the remaining thread end?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。短く切ってしまう前に、この端を残したままやり直せるか確認したかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残る糸端を示し短く切る前に相談したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. Before cutting it short, I wanted to check whether I could redo it while keeping this end.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the remaining thread end and explain that you asked before cutting it short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 糸はそのままにしてください。実演する間は、道具を台へ置いて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave the thread as it is. While I demonstrate, put the tools on the workbench and watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具を置きました。一度見てから、私が指す段で合っているか確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具を置き見学後に自分の指す段を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the tools down. After I watch once, could you check whether the row I point to is the right one?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put the tools down and ask them to check the row you indicate after watching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では一段を示します。次に作業する時は、こちらから声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll show you the row. I'll tell you when it's time for you to work next.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この横糸の段ですね。自分でやるときも、最初だけそばで見ていていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい段を指し自分の初作業もそばで見てもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: This weft row, right. When I do it myself, it would help if you could stay beside me and watch just at the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point to the correct row and ask them to watch beside you when you begin doing it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。まず私がやって見せますので、その後一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll demonstrate first, and then we'll check together.
